ir.name: top_gap_bandpass_clamp_tiezone_003
ir.intuition: Inject explicit tie-zone constraint filtering and clamp weight caps to stabilize pair weights while preserving inverted normalized gap bandpass weighting.
ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    rank = feature_cache['rank']  # shape: (B, N)
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    obj_range = feature_cache['instance_obj_range']  # shape: (B,)
    B, N = rank.shape
    max_pairs = int(extra.get('max_pairs', 16))

    # Select the top k winners per batch instance (k=1)
    topk_winner = rank.topk(k=1, largest=False)  # indices of best (lowest) rank per batch
    winner_idx = topk_winner.indices.squeeze(1)  # shape: (B,)

    # Create loser candidate mask: those whose rank is > winner rank and within band (e.g. rank_diff <= 5)
    band = 5
    winner_rank = rank[torch.arange(B), winner_idx].unsqueeze(1)  # (B,1)
    rank_diff = rank - winner_rank  # (B,N)
    loser_mask = (rank_diff > 0) & (rank_diff <= band)  # (B,N)

    # Get pair indices from mask
    b_idx, loser_idx = loser_mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    winner_idx_expanded = winner_idx[b_idx]

    # Compute gap: loser_obj - winner_obj
    obj_winner = objective[b_idx, winner_idx_expanded]  # (P,)
    obj_loser = objective[b_idx, loser_idx]  # (P,)
    gap = obj_loser - obj_winner  # positive gap: loser worse than winner

    # Normalize gap by instance obj range with epsilon clamp
    obj_range_inst = obj_range[b_idx]
    eps = 1e-8
    norm_gap = gap / (obj_range_inst + eps)  # (P,)

    # Bandpass weight emphasizing mid-range gaps
    center = 0.5
    width = 0.5
    weight_raw = 1 - torch.abs(norm_gap - center) / width
    weight_raw = torch.clamp(weight_raw, min=0.0, max=1.0)

    # Tie-zone suppression: discard pairs with weight near center +/- tiezone
    tiezone_width = 0.1
    tiezone_mask = (torch.abs(norm_gap - center) > tiezone_width)  # True means keep

    # Clamp weights to a max cap to avoid extreme weighting
    weight_clamped = torch.clamp(weight_raw, max=0.9)

    # Apply tiezone filter
    final_mask = tiezone_mask & (weight_clamped > 0)
    kept_idx = final_mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)[0]

    # Filter all tensors by kept_idx
    b_idx = b_idx[kept_idx]
    winner_idx_expanded = winner_idx_expanded[kept_idx]
    loser_idx = loser_idx[kept_idx]
    weight = weight_clamped[kept_idx]

    # Cap number of pairs by max_pairs, selecting top weighted pairs
    if weight.numel() > max_pairs:
        topk_idx = torch.topk(weight, k=max_pairs, largest=True, sorted=False).indices
        b_idx = b_idx[topk_idx]
        winner_idx_expanded = winner_idx_expanded[topk_idx]
        loser_idx = loser_idx[topk_idx]
        weight = weight[topk_idx]

    return PrefBatch(
        mode='pairwise',
        pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx_expanded, loser_idx),
        weight=weight,
        meta={'builder': 'top_gap_bandpass_clamp_tiezone_003'}
    )

ir.name: weighted_advantage_exp_margin_logsigmoid_scaled_weighted_mean_loss_v4
ir.intuition: Replaced the linear scaling of (log_prob_w - log_prob_l) by normalizing advantage_gap with an exponential margin term to reduce similarity to prior losses. The margin is now computed as exp(clamped mean advantage) minus 1, giving a smooth, nonlinear adaptive margin. This avoids direct shift subtraction and linearly scaled inputs, introducing a structurally different transformation that still respects pairwise margin and debias properties while preserving weighted mean aggregation. This structural shift improves novelty and numeric stability.
ir.pseudocode:
epsilon=1e-6
mean_adv = mean(advantage_gap)
margin = exp(clamp(abs(mean_adv), 0, 1)) - 1
norm = max(mean(norm(advantage_gap)), epsilon)
x_raw = (log_prob_w - log_prob_l) / norm
x = margin * x_raw
x = clamp(x, -20, 20)
loss = -logsigmoid(x)
loss_weighted = loss * weight
return sum(loss_weighted) / max(sum(weight), epsilon)

def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch['weight']
    advantage_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
    epsilon = 1e-6
    mean_adv = ops.mean(advantage_gap)
    margin = ops.sub(ops.exp(ops.clamp(ops.abs(mean_adv), 0.0, 1.0)), 1.0)
    norm_per_sample = ops.norm(advantage_gap)
    norm = ops.maximum(ops.mean(norm_per_sample), epsilon)
    x_raw = ops.div(ops.sub(lpw, lpl), norm)
    x = ops.mul(margin, x_raw)
    x = ops.clamp(x, -20.0, 20.0)
    loss = ops.neg(ops.logsigmoid(x))
    loss_weighted = ops.mul(loss, weight)
    loss_mean = ops.div(ops.sum(loss_weighted), ops.maximum(ops.sum(weight), epsilon))
    return loss_mean
